Definition: Understandability refers to how easily developers can comprehend and maintain the test code.

Task: Improve the understandability of the test `TestSymmetry010Chronology_test_range.java` (path:- /Users/tenghaha/Projects/New_Agent_understandability_improvement/data/original/threeten-extra/manual/testcases/TestSymmetry010Chronology/TestSymmetry010Chronology_test_range.java). The refactored code must be syntactically correct and compilable against the provided CUT signatures. Do not alter the runtime behaviour of the original test: the same methods must be called with the same arguments and produce the same expected outcomes.

The test only exercises `test_range` via the `data_ranges` provider. All the other `data_*` methods are dead code (never referenced), and a large portion of the imports exist only to support that dead code. Removing them and clarifying the surviving data set improves understandability without changing what runs.Compiles cleanly (`COMPILE_OK`). I refactored the test to focus on the only behavior it actually exercises—`Symmetry010Date.range(field)` via `data_ranges`/`test_range`—removing the dead data-provider methods and now-unused imports, formatting each case on its own line, and grouping them by field with comments explaining the common-year vs. leap-year ranges. The same parameterized cases run with the same expected outcomes.
